Deep TMS Therapy

How Much Does Deep TMS Cost? A Comprehensive 2026 Guide

April 7, 2026 Resiliency Mind+Body Medicine®

Deep Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (Deep TMS) is one of the most advanced, FDA-cleared treatments for depression, OCD, and other mental health conditions, especially for patients who haven't found relief with medications. To understand how Deep TMS works, read our comprehensive guide on Deep TMS therapy mechanisms.

If you're considering treatment, cost is naturally one of the first questions. This guide focuses on the real patient experience at Resiliency Mind+Body Medicine®, including actual pricing, insurance coverage, and what most patients truly pay out-of-pocket.

What Is Deep TMS and Why Is It Different?

Deep TMS uses specialized H-Coil technology to stimulate deeper and broader brain regions than standard TMS. For comparison, learn how Spravato coverage compares to other treatment options.

FDA-cleared for:

  • Major Depressive Disorder (MDD)
  • Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder (OCD)
  • Smoking addiction (select protocols)

Why patients choose Deep TMS:

  • Targets deeper neural circuits tied to mood
  • Effective for treatment-resistant depression
  • Non-invasive (no anesthesia required)
  • No systemic side effects like medication

For many patients, this becomes the next step after trying multiple medications without success.

Deep TMS Cost at Resiliency Mind+Body Medicine®

Let's focus on what patients actually experience at our clinic.

1. Total Cost of a Full Treatment Course

A standard Deep TMS protocol includes:

  • 30–36 sessions
  • 5 sessions per week
  • ~6 weeks duration

Our actual pricing:

  • $250 per session (self-pay)
  • $7,500 to $12,500 total treatment cost depending on the number of sessions

This reflects real-world treatment plans based on the number of sessions required.

Note: National averages and some clinics in the area may quote significantly higher ranges, often exceeding $15,000+.

2. Session Duration (A Key Convenience Advantage)

While many sources list TMS sessions at ~20 minutes:

At Resiliency:

  • Typical session time: ~10 minutes

This shorter treatment time is a meaningful advantage for patients balancing work, family, and daily responsibilities.

Insurance Coverage: The Most Important Factor

For most patients, insurance, not sticker price, determines cost. If you're comparing treatment options, see our guide to Spravato insurance coverage as an alternative treatment.

At Resiliency Mind+Body Medicine®, we are in-network with:

  • Commercial insurance plans
  • Medicare
  • Medicare Advantage
  • Medi-Cal

What this means for you:

  • Many patients receive treatment at little to no cost
  • Medi-Cal patients: $0 out-of-pocket
  • Medicare + supplement: $0 out-of-pocket
  • Some commercial & Medicare Advantage plans: fully covered

This is one of the biggest differentiators of receiving care at Resiliency. We prioritize accessibility alongside treatment availability.

What Most Patients Actually Pay

Instead of broad national estimates, here's what patients typically experience:

With insurance:

  • Often minimal out-of-pocket costs
  • In many cases: fully covered treatment

Without insurance (self-pay):

  • $250 per session
  • $7,500–$12,500 total

You'll always receive:

  • Insurance verification before starting
  • Prior authorization support
  • A clear, upfront cost breakdown

Why National Cost Ranges Can Be Misleading

You may see ranges like:

  • $350–$600 per session
  • $10,000–$18,000 total

While directionally accurate across the U.S., these numbers:

  • Often reflect higher-cost markets or out-of-network clinics
  • Don't account for insurance coverage
  • Can overestimate what most patients actually pay

At Resiliency, the goal is to make treatment both clinically effective and financially accessible.

What Influences Your Final Cost?

1. Insurance Approval

Most major insurers cover Deep TMS when:

  • You have a diagnosis of depression
  • You've tried 2+ antidepressants
  • Medical necessity is documented

2. Number of Sessions

  • Standard: 30–36 sessions
  • Some patients may need additional or maintenance sessions

3. Individual Treatment Plan

Your care is customized, which can slightly affect total cost.

Deep TMS vs Other Mental Health Treatment Costs

Treatment Cost Structure Long-Term Expense
Medications Monthly Ongoing
Therapy Weekly Ongoing
Deep TMS Structured course Often finite

While TMS has an upfront cost, it may:

  • Reduce long-term medication use
  • Decrease ongoing therapy needs
  • Provide longer-lasting relief

Is Deep TMS Worth It?

For many patients, especially those with treatment-resistant depression:

  • High response and remission rates
  • Minimal side effects
  • No downtime
  • Long-term benefits

And importantly, when covered by insurance, cost is often far lower than expected.

Cost Transparency at Resiliency Mind+Body Medicine®

We prioritize clarity and access. Every patient receives:

  • Full insurance verification
  • Prior authorization handling
  • Clear, upfront pricing
  • Personalized treatment planning

Serving:

  • Newport Beach, CA
  • San Juan Capistrano, CA
  • Irvine, Dana Point, Mission Viejo & surrounding Orange County areas

FAQs About Deep TMS Cost

1. Is Deep TMS covered by insurance?

Yes. Most major plans cover treatment when clinical criteria are met. Many patients pay little to nothing out-of-pocket.

2. How long does treatment take?

  • ~6 weeks total
  • ~10 minutes per session at our clinic

3. Can treatment really be free?

Yes. For details on coverage options, see our insurance coverage guide.

  • Medi-Cal patients: $0
  • Medicare + supplement: $0
  • Some commercial/Medicare Advantage plans: fully covered

4. What if I don't have insurance?

Self-pay is:

  • $250 per session
  • $7,500–$12,500 total

Payment options may be available.

5. Are there hidden costs?

No. We provide full transparency, including:

  • Consultation
  • Mapping
  • Treatment sessions

6. Will I need treatment again?

Some patients benefit from maintenance sessions, but many achieve long-term relief after one course. Learn more about how Deep TMS creates lasting changes through neuroplasticity.

Ready to Understand Your Exact Cost?

The best way to know your real cost is through a personalized consultation. At Resiliency Mind+Body Medicine®, we'll help you understand:

  • If you're a candidate for Deep TMS
  • Your insurance coverage
  • Your exact out-of-pocket cost

Schedule your consultation today in Newport Beach or San Juan Capistrano and get a clear, personalized treatment and financial plan.
